runs.say: How do I make a vertical version of this for Instagram Reels?
runs.reply:
The help articles don't describe any way to reframe or crop a video to vertical in Voltage, so I can't point you to a setting for it. Voltage works on what the clip says and how it sounds, not on its shape. What "Make a variant" (under Exporting) does is copy this clip and its plan into a new draft in the same project. That's useful for a second version of the read, but it keeps the landscape picture.

The usual route is to export the vertical cut from your video editor, upload it here, and I'll match the voice line to it. Since the vertical card will probably time the words differently, I'd recheck "today" against the new highlight.
